map.平面点绕原点旋转: Rotate a Plane Point About the Origin
map.📖 查看「平面点绕原点旋转 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Rotate a Plane Point About the Origin User Guide"
map.把点绕原点旋转 θ 得新坐标。: Rotate a point about the origin by θ to get new coordinates.
map.θ=30°、点(2,0) → x'=2×0.866=1.732，y'=2×0.5: θ=30°, point (2,0) → x' = 2×0.866 = 1.732, y' = 2×0.5 = 1.0 → (1.732,1.0), used to rotate a building axis to true north.
map.x'=x cosθ−y sinθ，y'=x sinθ+y cosθ；逆时针为正，: x' = x cosθ − y sinθ, y' = x sinθ + y cosθ; counterclockwise positive; mind the sign and radians.
map.旋转是转换的一部分，配合平移/尺度才完整（四参数）。: Rotation is part of conversion; together with translation/scale it is complete (four-parameter).
